description: Structured eval definitions for the AWS Budget Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across budget types (cost with action tier, RI utilization, SP coverage + anomaly, zero-spend sandbox with EC2 stop) and missing-prerequisite branches. Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Production cost budget with IAM policy action tier + anomaly subscription
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — all checklist items verified, IAM policy action wired, FORECAST + ACTUAL thresholds, anomaly subscription on default monitor
eval_cases.prompt: Provision a production AWS Budget named "prod-monthly-cost" in account 111111111111 for the whole account (no filters). Budget amount $10,000 USD MONTHLY. Alerts at 80/90/100% ACTUAL and 100% FORECAST to SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy already allows budgets.amazonaws.com and ce.amazonaws.com). Budget action: APPLY_IAM_POLICY (arn:aws:iam::111111111111:policy/BudgetDenyAll) on SandboxAppRole at 100% ACTUAL, ApprovalModel AUTOMATIC. ExecutionRoleArn arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/BudgetActionsRole (trust verified on budgets.amazonaws.com). Also wire Cost Anomaly Detection: default monitor, subscription prod-anomaly-subscription Threshold $100 DAILY to the same SNS topic.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUDGET: prod-monthly-cost in 111111111111 (account-wide)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Budget type: COST
  [✓] Scope: account-wide | Amount: $10,000 USD | MONTHLY
  [✓] Alerts: 80/90/100% ACTUAL + 100% FORECAST → SNS budget-alerts
  [✓] Budget actions: APPLY_IAM_POLICY (BudgetDenyAll on SandboxAppRole) at 100% ACTUAL, AUTOMATIC
  [✓] Action role: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/BudgetActionsRole (trust verified: budgets.amazonaws.com)
  [✓] SNS topic: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy allows budgets + ce)
  [✓] Cost anomaly: default monitor + prod-anomaly-subscription (Threshold $100, DAILY, SNS)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws budgets describe-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name prod-monthly-cost
  aws budgets describe-notifications-for-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name prod-monthly-cost
  aws budgets describe-budget-actions --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name prod-monthly-cost
  aws ce get-anomaly-subscriptions

eval_cases.name: RI utilization budget at 80% target with LESS_THAN threshold
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — RI_UTILIZATION budget, notifications only (no budget actions — API rejects on usage budgets)
eval_cases.prompt: Provision an AWS Budget for RI Utilization in account 111111111111. Budget name "ri-util-target". Target 80% MONTHLY. Alert me when utilization drops below 80% ACTUAL via SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy allows budgets.amazonaws.com). We have RIs on EC2 m5.large in us-east-1. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUDGET: ri-util-target in 111111111111
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Budget type: RI_UTILIZATION
  [✓] Amount / target: 80% utilization (LESS_THAN_THRESHOLD)
  [✓] Time period: MONTHLY
  [✓] Alerts: 80% ACTUAL LESS_THAN → SNS budget-alerts
  [✓] Budget actions: none (RI_USAGE budgets do NOT support budget actions — API rejects)
  [✓] SNS topic: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy verified)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws budgets describe-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name ri-util-target
  aws budgets describe-notifications-for-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name ri-util-target

eval_cases.name: SP coverage budget + dimensional anomaly monitor with ce.amazonaws.com SNS principal
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — SP_COVERAGE budget (latest GA) + dimensional SERVICE anomaly monitor, ce.amazonaws.com SNS principal verified
eval_cases.prompt: Set up spend guardrails for account 111111111111. Two things: (1) A Savings Plan Coverage budget at 80% MONTHLY, alert when coverage drops below 80% ACTUAL via SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy allows budgets.amazonaws.com AND ce.amazonaws.com). (2) Cost Anomaly Detection with a dimensional SERVICE monitor and subscription Threshold $250 DAILY to the same SNS topic. Account: 111111111111.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUDGET: sp-coverage-target in 111111111111
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Budget type: SP_COVERAGE
  [✓] Amount / target: 80% coverage (LESS_THAN_THRESHOLD)
  [✓] Time period: MONTHLY
  [✓] Alerts: 80% ACTUAL LESS_THAN → SNS budget-alerts
  [✓] Budget actions: none (SP_USAGE budgets do NOT support budget actions)
  [✓] SNS topic: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:budget-alerts (policy verified for budgets AND ce)
  [✓] Cost anomaly monitor: dimensional SERVICE
  [✓] Cost anomaly subscription: Threshold $250, DAILY, SNS
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws budgets describe-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name sp-coverage-target
  aws ce get-anomaly-monitors
  aws ce get-anomaly-subscriptions

eval_cases.name: Zero-spend sandbox guardrail with IAM + EC2 stop actions
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — $0.01 zero-spend budget with 50% ACTUAL (fires on first dollar), APPLY_IAM_POLICY + RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS actions at 100%
eval_cases.prompt: Set up a zero-spend guardrail on sandbox account 111111111111. Budget name "sandbox-zero-spend", MONTHLY, amount $0.01. Alert at 50% ACTUAL (so we catch the first dollar) and 100% ACTUAL to SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:security-alerts (policy allows budgets.amazonaws.com). At 100% ACTUAL, run APPLY_IAM_POLICY on SandboxFullAccessRole with policy arn:aws:iam::111111111111:policy/BudgetDenyAll. Also at 100% ACTUAL, run RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS STOP_EC2_INSTANCES on i-0aaa111222bbb33344 in us-east-1. ExecutionRoleArn arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/BudgetActionsRole (trust verified on budgets.amazonaws.com). ApprovalModel AUTOMATIC.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUDGET: sandbox-zero-spend in 111111111111
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Budget type: COST
  [✓] Amount: $0.01 USD (zero-spend guardrail — 50% threshold fires on first dollar)
  [✓] Time period: MONTHLY
  [✓] Alerts: 50% ACTUAL + 100% ACTUAL → SNS security-alerts
  [✓] Budget actions:
        - APPLY_IAM_POLICY (BudgetDenyAll on SandboxFullAccessRole) at 100% ACTUAL, AUTOMATIC
        - RUN_SSM_DOCUMENTS STOP_EC2_INSTANCES on i-0aaa111222bbb33344 at 100% ACTUAL, AUTOMATIC
  [✓] Action role: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/BudgetActionsRole (trust verified)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws budgets describe-budget --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name sandbox-zero-spend
  aws budgets describe-budget-actions --account-id 111111111111 --budget-name sandbox-zero-spend

eval_cases.name: Operator missing ExecutionRoleArn and SNS topic lacks budgets.amazonaws.com principal
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — ExecutionRoleArn not provided + SNS topic policy lacks budgets.amazonaws.com
eval_cases.prompt: Help me create an AWS Budget for account 111111111111 named "dev-spend". Budget $5,000 MONTHLY. I want a budget action that applies an IAM deny policy at 100% ACTUAL. Use SNS topic arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:dev-alerts (policy currently only allows lambda.amazonaws.com to publish). Region: us-east-1.
eval_cases.expected_output:
BUDGET: dev-spend in 111111111111
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] ExecutionRoleArn: NOT specified — budget action requires a role trusting budgets.amazonaws.com
  [✗] SNS topic policy: arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:dev-alerts allows only lambda.amazonaws.com — must add budgets.amazonaws.com (and ce.amazonaws.com if anomaly alerts will use the same topic)
  [✗] IAM policy ARN for APPLY_IAM_POLICY: not specified
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws iam list-roles --query 'Roles[?contains(AssumeRolePolicyDocument, `budgets.amazonaws.com`)]'
  aws sns get-topic-attributes --topic-arn arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:111111111111:dev-alerts --query 'Attributes.Policy'
